definitions.explanation: A firm, gelatinous food made from the root of the konjac plant (devil's tongue), with a chewy texture and virtually no calories.

notes:
WRITING:
- Also written {蒟蒻|こんにゃく}, mostly on menus and packaging.

TYPES:
- ⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧こんにゃく: block konnyaku
- ⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧こんにゃく / ⟦しらたき→しらたき：07480_shirataki⟧: noodle-shaped konnyaku
- ⟦{玉|たま}→玉：02221_tama⟧こんにゃく: ball-shaped konnyaku

USAGE:
Popular as a diet food because it is mostly water and fiber. It is often scored with a knife (⟦{隠|かく}し{包丁|ぼうちょう}→隠し包丁：30651_kakushibouchou⟧) or torn by hand so that it soaks up flavor, and it appears in ⟦おでん→おでん：14727_oden⟧, ⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧ and stir-fries.
